## Overview

- [Accept Payments](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/docs/): Accept and process cards, wallets, and Local Payment Methods in a single, modern integration. Store customer and payment information to reduce friction at checkout.
- [Build with](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/graphql/): These guides cover some of the core concepts and tools you'll need to begin building your integration.
- [Support Articles](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/articles/): Learn about the business side of processing with Braintree.
- [help](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/help): Submit a request for help with your PayPal Braintree sandbox or production account.
- [Braintree In-Person](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree/in-person/): The Braintree platform enables next-generation omnichannel commerce experiences across in-person, e-commerce, mobile app, and other merchant sales channels.
